stemMd: Why could the measured improvement coexist with teachers’ complaints?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The teachers must have invented every distraction

options.label: B
options.textMd: Reverberation time measures the width of a door

options.label: C
options.textMd: The measurement addressed reflections, while the complaint involved incoming sound

options.label: D
options.textMd: Measurements and observations can never be combined

options.label: E
options.textMd: Soft panels necessarily amplify every external sound

explanationMd: Two different mechanisms affected the experience. Absorption reduced internal reflections, while leakage through the door still admitted sound. The evidence is compatible once the measured property is distinguished from the remaining problem.

distractorRationale.a: Their observations are consistent with a separate acoustic problem.
distractorRationale.b: It describes sound decay, not geometry directly.
distractorRationale.e: The passage makes no such claim.
